# Angular 3D Factory Builder Game

This is an Angular-based 3D factory builder game with top-down view using sprite-style graphics.

## Project Features
- 3D rendered environment with top-down perspective
- Sprite-based graphics system
- Factory building mechanics
- Resource progression system
- Research tree for technology advancement
- Material processing from low-level to high-tech

## Development Guidelines
- Use Angular 18+ with TypeScript
- Implement Three.js for 3D rendering
- Modular component architecture for game systems
- State management for game progression
- Responsive design for various screen sizes

## Project Setup Complete ✅

The Angular workspace has been successfully set up with:
- Three.js integration for 3D graphics
- Game engine service for core game logic
- Game component with UI overlay
- Resource management system
- Building placement mechanics
- Research tree foundation
- Development server running on localhost:4200
